chars.R: RACHID: a slim young man wearing a bright red tracksuit jacket with white stripes on the sleeves, black jogging trousers, white sneakers.
chars.S: SALWA: a young woman wearing a lilac hijab, a light blue denim jacket over a long mustard-yellow dress, a small black crossbody bag.
chars.M: SFENJ SELLER: a chubby older man wearing an old worn brown leather jacket over a stained white apron and a grey flat cap.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In front of a small traditional sfenj (Moroccan doughnut) shop in a popular narrow street of Mansouria, Morocco, sunny day. SALWA stands with arms crossed, pouting and annoyed, pointing at the sfenj shop; RACHID stands facing her, embarrassed and sweating, staring at a single small coin in his open palm. Comic awkward tension between them.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Same popular Moroccan street near the sfenj shop. SALWA holds out her open hand demanding the coin with a smug look; RACHID leans toward her with a cheeky sneaky grin, whispering a plan, hand beside his mouth, his eyes glancing sideways at the sfenj shop.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: A happy daydream: RACHID and SALWA walk side by side along the seaside promenade of Mohammedia, each holding a golden ring-shaped sfenj doughnut, laughing, sunny sky and sea behind them, warm soft dreamy light.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Inside the wide old sfenj shop: the SFENJ SELLER stands behind a long counter frying ring-shaped dough in a huge black pan of bubbling oil, busy and distracted, a pile of golden sfenj doughnuts on the counter beside him, steam rising, a gas bottle on the floor.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: RACHID stands just outside the doorway of the sfenj shop, rubbing his hands together with a confident mischievous grin, eyes fixed on the pile of sfenj doughnuts on the counter inside, like a little thief planning a heist.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: On the street outside the sfenj shop, SALWA wags her finger at RACHID with a teasing challenging smile, laughing at him; RACHID puffs out his chest, offended and determined to prove himself.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Inside the sfenj shop: two women customers in djellabas (simple bald white head style like the others) argue loudly with the SFENJ SELLER at one end of the counter, keeping him busy; at the other end RACHID sidles along the counter on tiptoe, pretending to look innocent.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Close view of the sfenj shop counter: RACHID's round white mitten hand sneaks slowly toward the pile of golden sfenj doughnuts while the SFENJ SELLER has his back turned, stirring the big pan. RACHID looks nervous and excited.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Tense moment in the sfenj shop: RACHID leans far over the counter on his tiptoes, stretching his arm toward the fresh hot sfenj next to the huge black pan of bubbling boiling oil, his foot near a gas bottle hose on the floor; danger, suspense.
